decisionsTitle: «Termene» in seven named folds, and a glyph on every sub-tab of «Setări» (amending §377, §456, §389, §513, §318 and §516)
decisionsSection:
**The owner, 2026-10-18, from a screenshot of «Setări» → «Termene»:** «partea asta de termene trebuie grupată mai bine; de asemenea, vreau și la subtaburi să am iconițe.»

**Decision.** The screen keeps its outer card «Termene», its closed line and its intro, and inside it the thirteen boxes sit in **seven named folds**, in this order: «Confirmarea adresei» (the link's hours, when it is re-sent, how many times), «Locul ținut și oferta», «Înainte de start» (the reminder, the last call to sign, «Am ajuns», the countdown), «După eveniment» (the public list), «Seriile», «Înscrierea de familie» and «Când site-ul nu răspunde». Which box sits in which fold is data in the domain — `DEADLINE_GROUPS` beside `DEADLINE_KEYS`, with a test that every deadline is in exactly one — and the words are the catalogue's (`Admin.emails.deadlines.groups`, `short`, `shortZero`, `differsCount`). Each fold is a level-3 `Panel`: closed, a glyph, and a closed line made of its boxes' values in force in the house's duration words (`deadlineDuration`, over the same phrases as the sentences that state them) and, when any is off the recommendation, «N diferit de recomandat» — the stored values, never the typed ones, as the chip beside the box (§456) is. **The form is still one**: one «Salvează termenele» and one «Completează valorile recomandate», under the folds and outside them, so a refused number in a closed fold never costs the others; `ActionForm` already opens the folds around a box a refusal names (`revealField`), which is how a refusal reaches a closed fold. «Maxim de înscrieri pe o adresă» (§389) and «Când pleacă emailurile» (§513) become two named cards of their own beside the folds — a glyph, a closed line («cel mult 4 persoane pe adresă»; «la trecerea programată, în cel mult o oră»), their own saves unchanged — and open on their own save. A reader who may not change the numbers sees the same seven folds with the values and no form. Nothing saved or validated changes.

**A glyph on every sub-tab.** The six tabs of «Setări»' row — «Emailuri», «Termene», «Aspect», «Costuri», «Anti-robot», «Configurație» — each wear a picture before their words, the way «Pagini»' do (§524): the mail, the timer, the palette, the coin (the files of the cards' glyphs where the subject is the same), a shield for the anti-robot check and a gear for the platform's configuration; `/devs`' own panels in the same row take the gear. They are elements drawn in `SettingsSubNav`, a Server Component, into `SubNav`, a Server Component end to end, so nothing crosses into a client island. A glyph before every tab, fold and button is §318 as amended on 2026-09-27; this finishes the tabs. **No `short` word was added**: the row is wider than 288 px by design and scrolls inside itself with the current tab brought into view (§731), with or without the pictures — a shorter word would not make six tabs fit, and the e2e spec at 320 px holds that the page does not widen.

**Refused.** Moving the folds' words into code (the sentences stay in the catalogue, only the numbers' phrases are code); a fold per box (a single box in a fold of its own is three of the seven, kept because each is a different subject the club looks for by name); a save per fold (one list of boxes keeps one save, the owner's rule of 2026-10-16); a new tab or a renamed tab.
changelogLine: - **«Termene» in seven named folds, a glyph on every settings sub-tab** — the thirteen deadlines sit in «Confirmarea adresei», «Locul ținut și oferta», «Înainte de start», «După eveniment», «Seriile», «Înscrierea de familie» and «Când site-ul nu răspunde», each closed with its values in words and how many differ from the recommendation, one save under them; the limit per address and «Când pleacă emailurile» are cards of their own; «Emailuri», «Termene», «Aspect», «Costuri», «Anti-robot» and «Configurație» each have an icon. §NNN.

specsCriteria.text: The «Termene» screen draws the club's deadlines in seven named folds, closed by default, each with a glyph and a closed line of its deadlines' values in force in words, plus how many differ from the recommendation; which deadline sits in which fold is `DEADLINE_GROUPS`, and every deadline is in exactly one. The form stays one, with one save and one «Completează valorile recomandate» outside the folds, and a refused number opens the fold that holds it; the limit per address and «Când pleacă emailurile» are cards of their own with their own saves. Nothing saved or validated changes (2026-10-18, `DECISIONS.md` §NNN).

Every sub-tab of «Setări»' row, «Configurație» and the panels of `/devs` included, carries a glyph before its words, `aria-hidden`, and at 320 px the row scrolls inside itself with the current tab in view and the page does not widen; the seven folds of «Termene», opened, fit the width with a 44-pixel bar each (2026-10-18, `DECISIONS.md` §NNN).

batchLine: «Termene» in seven named folds with summaries; a glyph on every settings sub-tab
